about: Homework for this pillar, one list per AI (Claude writes it; tools/kit/render.py in jpavia10/prometheus-hub turns it into docs/agents/QUEUE_{ai}.md and the Drive docs). Every task says exactly what to read, what to make, how many, where to save it, how Claude checks it and what makes it not done. A task is done only when the file passes the checks, never because it was sent.

tasks.title: Continuity: Legacy-contact and inactive-account policies of 30 services
tasks.why: Owner, 2026-11-16: every pillar loaded with homework so it stops opening empty; this is public data Continuity uses.
steps: Google Inactive Account Manager, Apple Legacy Contact, Facebook, Microsoft, banks, password managers; each from its own help page.

deliver.shape: JSON array of objects, one per row: {"n","service","what happens when you die or go inactive","how to set it up","URL","quote"}

tasks.done_when: 30 rows (or the whole document) in the shape, every source opening and saying what the row says.
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a real private person's name, address or phone number
anything about Joseph's own accounts, balances, mail, messages or records (public facts only)

tasks.title: Continuity: 20 features the best digital-legacy and emergency vaults have
tasks.why: Owner, 2026-11-16: every pillar loaded with homework so it stops opening empty; this is public data Continuity uses.
steps: Look at digital-legacy and emergency vaults (Everplans, Trustworthy, 1Password Emergency Kit).
Only features the app's own page, help centre or store listing shows; no guesses.
Sort by how much the feature would help a person using this pillar every day.

tasks.title: Continuity: second reader on Gemini's 'Legacy-contact and inactive-account policies of 30 services'

inputs: Gemini's file continuity_gemini_legacy-policies_*.json in the folder below (once it is there)
steps: Open 15 rows at random (or every row if fewer) and the source each cites.
For each: what Gemini says, what the page says, agree/differ.
Add up to 5 rows Gemini missed, same shape.
